summary: Complete testing of new Super Admin subscription details feature. All functionality verified - backend endpoint and frontend modal both working correctly.
passed_tests: Free plan user shows: Plan=Free, Currency=N/A, Stripe IDs=N/A
Starter plan user shows: Plan=Starter, Currency correctly derived
Growth plan user shows: Plan=Growth, Currency correctly derived
Permanent starter user (dhruvmathur5@gmail.com) shows: is_permanent_plan=true, billing_status=permanent
Permanent growth user (perfectdigitals208@gmail.com) shows: is_permanent_plan=true, billing_status=permanent
Trialing user shows: trial_active=true, trial_end_date populated
Admin action logged in admin_logs collection
CreditCard icon button visible in admin panel user rows
Subscription modal opens on clicking CreditCard button
Modal displays all required fields in organized layout
Modal shows permanent assignment note for permanent plan users
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint correctly combines local MongoDB data with Stripe API data
Permanent plan detection uses PERMANENT_PLAN_ASSIGNMENTS from environment variables
Stripe API errors are handled gracefully - local data is shown if Stripe fails
Admin actions are properly logged to admin_logs collection
Frontend modal has all required data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing database users for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin subscription details feature fully implemented and tested. Endpoint at GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}/subscription. Returns: current_plan, currency, stripe_customer_id, stripe_subscription_id, stripe_price_id, billing_status, trial_active, trial_end_date, subscription_end_date, is_permanent_plan. For permanent plan users (defined in PERMANENT_PLAN_*_EMAILS env vars), billing_status='permanent' and notes field is populated. Frontend modal accessible via CreditCard icon in Actions column of admin user table.

backend_endpoint.auth: Requires super_admin role (403 for non-admins, 401 for unauthenticated)

frontend_modal.trigger: CreditCard icon button in admin user table Actions column
